Folks — following Marcus' notes and Jordan's ask, I built a quick MQL definition sheet and exported a filtered attendee CSV for Acme (attached). Please use the HubSpot tags I list below when creating tasks:

MQL rules (final):
- Hot: attended live AND (engagement_score >= 75 OR asked a product question) -> tag: webinar_hot
- Warm: attended live AND engagement_score between 40-74 -> tag: webinar_warm
- Cold: registered but no-show OR engagement_score < 40 -> tag: webinar_nurture

Routing matrix:
- webinar_hot -> AE outreach (Marcus) + SDR claim (Stephanie) — immediate task in HubSpot (priority = 1)
- webinar_warm -> SDR sequence (Ben) -> AE if reply (priority = 2)
- webinar_nurture -> nurture campaign (Marketing) (priority = 3)
